fusions.name: Left the Barb In
fusions.desc: A stinging weapon strike that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Buzzing Circuit
fusions.desc: You scurry a tight circle, stinging every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 3 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Nest Pours Out
fusions.desc: Empties the nest: a swarm of mice fights for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Idle
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, 5 stamina comes back to you. Once every 4 seconds.
